title: papaver rhoeas f. integrifolium
intro: Papaver rhoeas f. integrifolium, commonly known as the red poppy or corn poppy, is a flowering plant species that is native to Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat a variety of health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Papaver rhoeas f. integrifolium are attributed to its sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to calm the mind and body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
